data.name: Angad
data.gender_notes: Angad is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit aṅgada, 'an armlet, ornament'. Its root is Sanskrit aṅgada (अङ्गद). Angada, a monkey prince in the Ramayana. Angad is a Sanskrit name meaning “An ornament; a monkey prince”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Angad expresses “An ornament; a monkey prince”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit aṅgada, 'an armlet, ornament'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Angad total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
